panels.title: Incoming Packets / sec
panels.description: Rate of packets received by GoFlow2, grouped by exporter address.

panels.title: Incoming Traffic (Mbps)
panels.description: Ingress traffic rate derived from GoFlow2 received-byte counter.

panels.title: Decoded Data Records / sec
panels.description: Rate of records in DataFlowSet messages. Template and options records are intentionally excluded.

panels.title: NetFlow Messages Processed / sec
panels.description: Rate of NetFlow messages processed by GoFlow2.

panels.title: Decoder Errors / sec
panels.description: Rate of GoFlow2 decoder errors, grouped by decoder name.

panels.title: Processing Errors / sec
panels.description: Rate of GoFlow2 NetFlow processing errors, grouped by error type.

panels.title: Flow-to-Processing Delay
panels.description: GoFlow2 Summary quantiles for flow timestamp-to-processing delay. These are exporter-reported quantiles, not CPU decode duration; do not aggregate quantiles across instances.

panels.title: GoFlow2 Resident Memory
panels.description: Current resident memory of the GoFlow2 process.

panels.title: Go Runtime Goroutines
panels.description: Current number of Go goroutines in the GoFlow2 process.

panels.title: GoFlow2 Metrics Scrape
panels.description: Prometheus target health for the GoFlow2 metrics Service.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Availability
panels.description: Exporter connection health: 1 = reachable, 0 = unavailable.

panels.title: IPFIX Database Size
panels.description: Current size of the shared ipfix database.

panels.title: Database Connections
panels.description: Current backend connections to the ipfix database.

panels.title: Connection Capacity Used
panels.description: Percentage of PostgreSQL max_connections used by ipfix database backends.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Connection States
panels.description: Current connections grouped by backend state for the shared ipfix database.

panels.title: Transaction Rate
panels.description: Committed and rolled-back transactions per second in the ipfix database.

panels.title: Transaction Rollbacks / sec
panels.description: Rate of transaction rollbacks. A rollback is not necessarily an application failure.

panels.title: Database Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Shared-buffer cache hit ratio based on cumulative block hit and read counters.

panels.title: Database Deadlocks
panels.description: Cumulative deadlocks recorded for the ipfix database since statistics reset.

panels.title: IPFIX Table Rows
panels.description: Estimated live row count in public.ipfix_flows.

panels.title: IPFIX Table Size
panels.description: On-disk table storage for public.ipfix_flows as reported by the exporter; index storage is tracked separately.

panels.title: PostgreSQL WAL Size
panels.description: Current size of PostgreSQL write-ahead log files.

panels.title: Kafka Consumer Group Lag
panels.description: Lag value reported by the KEDA Kafka scaler for ipfix-consumer-scaler.

panels.title: KEDA Scaler Active
panels.description: 1 = KEDA considers the Kafka trigger active; 0 = inactive.

panels.title: KEDA Errors
panels.description: Current cumulative error counters. Both should remain at zero.

panels.title: ScaledObject Paused
panels.description: 1 = ScaledObject is paused; 0 = normal autoscaling operation.

panels.title: Consumer Replicas — Current vs Desired
panels.description: HPA's observed current replica count compared with its desired replica count.

panels.title: Consumer Replica Limits — Min vs Max
panels.description: Configured minimum and maximum replicas for the IPFIX consumer HPA.

panels.title: KEDA Metric Retrieval Latency
panels.description: Time taken by KEDA to retrieve the Kafka scaler metric.

panels.title: KEDA Scaling Loop Latency
panels.description: Time taken by KEDA's internal scaling loop for the ScaledObject.
